title: Fix promote-verify audit check permission
objective: Fix promote-verify Audit permission: rustsec/audit-check finds no vulnerabilities but fails with Resource not accessible by integration when creating a check run because promote-verify.yml lacks checks: write permission.
acceptance_criteria: promote-verify.yml grants the minimum GitHub permissions needed by rustsec/audit-check: contents read and checks write.
Workflow YAML parses and local smoke verification remains green.
Post-promotion Audit check no longer fails with Resource not accessible by integration.
